name: rust-intel
description: Defense against LLM Rust failure modes: 58 categories of bugs that survive rustc, clippy, and cargo test — async cancellation, unsafe/FFI, concurrency, crypto, supply-chain, tests-that-pass-by-luck, semantic conformance, and systemic performance cost. Ships the rust-intel skill plus /rust-intel:audit, /rust-intel:fix, /rust-intel:plan commands.
